knowledge_graph.title: Clover High School
knowledge_graph.type: High school in York County, South Carolina
knowledge_graph.description: Clover High School is a public high school located in Clover, South Carolina, United States, about 28 miles from Charlotte. It is the only high school in the Clover School District. As of the 2024-2025 school year, the principal is Donna Farris.
